description: Backend trainer foundation + authorization + Firestore rules/indexes. Adds the server-trusted role field (resolved on /api/auth/verify, never from client), the trainers/referralCodes/trainerLinks data model, the idempotent dreamphysics / 'Dream Physics' trainer seed, the registration referral-link endpoint, the full trainer backend slice reusing existing per-feature services by passing studentUid as uid, server-side cross-trainer/cross-student authorization (requireTrainer + assertTrainerOwnsStudent returning 404 for unowned students), fail-closed firestore.rules, the single trainerLinks composite index, and the backend test suite. Depends on FEAT-001 only for a green baseline. This is the enabling layer for FEAT-003 and FEAT-004.
steps: roleService + role on verify (design §2.4-2.5, §5.1): add backend/src/services/roleService.ts resolveRole(uid)=users/{uid}.role ?? (trainers/{uid} exists ? 'trainer':'student'), purely computed, never writes role back. Add UserRepository.getRole(uid) in backend/src/repositories/userRepository.ts and confirm ensureAccount never writes/clears role. Extend authService.verifyAndSync to inject the resolved role into the returned account object (no authController.verify change needed).

Repositories + validators (design §3, §5.5): add backend/src/repositories/trainerRepository.ts (trainers/{trainerId} get/upsert, referralCodes/{codeLower} lookup, countActiveStudents(trainerId) via trainerLinks where trainerId==,status=='active'), backend/src/repositories/trainerLinkRepository.ts (trainerLinks/{studentUid} get, create-in-transaction, listByTrainer(trainerId)), and backend/src/validators/trainerValidators.ts (linkTrainerSchema {referralCode trimmed/lowercased min3 max40}, studentUidParamsSchema, dateQuerySchema reusing commonSchemas.dateKey.optional(), historyQuerySchema {limit coerce int 1..365 optional}, sharingPatchSchema {shareProgressWithTrainer boolean}).

Profile schema (design §3.2): add optional trainerId (string nullable) and shareProgressWithTrainer (boolean) to the profile upsert schema in backend/src/validators/profileValidators.ts so existing upserts and onboarding stay valid.

Seed script (design §2.4): add backend/src/scripts/seedTrainer.ts mirroring seedExercises.ts — read SEED_TRAINER_UID, idempotently upsert users/{uid}.role='trainer', trainers/{uid} (name 'Dream Physics', referralCode 'dreamphysics', referralCodeLower 'dreamphysics', totalStudents 0, status 'active', photoUrl null, timestamps), referralCodes/dreamphysics->{trainerId:uid}; guard on hasFirebaseCredentials(). Add 'seed:trainer': 'tsx src/scripts/seedTrainer.ts' to backend/package.json.

Middleware (design §5.1, §5.6): add backend/src/middleware/role.ts with requireTrainer (resolves role after authenticate, throws 403 ForbiddenError if not trainer) and assertTrainerOwnsStudent(trainerId, studentUid) (reads trainerLinks/{studentUid}; throws 404 NotFoundError if missing OR trainerId mismatch OR status!=='active').

Link endpoint (design §5.2): add POST /api/auth/link-trainer in backend/src/routes/auth.routes.ts (authenticated, validate body linkTrainerSchema) -> authController.linkTrainer -> trainerService.linkStudent(uid, code): normalize code, lookup referralCodes/{code}; absent -> 200 {linked:false, reason:'invalid_code'}; present -> Firestore transaction creating trainerLinks/{uid} status 'active', mirror profile/data.trainerId, increment trainers/{trainerId}.totalStudents (idempotent, no double count if link exists); trainer-role account -> 409 ConflictError; return {linked:true, trainerId, trainerName}.

Trainer + student slices (design §5.3-5.4): add backend/src/routes/trainer.routes.ts (all behind authenticate + requireTrainer) + controllers/trainerController.ts + extend services/trainerService.ts for GET /api/trainer/profile (live active-student count authoritative over stored counter), GET /api/trainer/students (per-student summaries from profile/data + latest workouts + today foodLogs/waterLogs), and per-student overview, workouts?date=, workouts/history?limit=, nutrition?date= (reuse nutritionService.getDay(studentUid,date)), water?date=, progress, photos (gated by shareProgressWithTrainer, signed URLs). Each per-student handler calls assertTrainerOwnsStudent(req.uid, studentUid) FIRST. Add backend/src/routes/student.routes.ts + controllers/studentController.ts: GET /api/student/trainer (non-active link -> {trainer:null}) and PATCH /api/student/trainer/sharing. Extend backend/src/services/progressPhotoService.ts with an authorized short-lived V4 signed-URL method (per-photo url:null on signing failure; storage.rules unchanged). Mount /api/trainer and /api/student in backend/src/app.ts.

Firestore rules/indexes (design §3.6, §4): in firebase/firestore.rules add explicit client deny matches for trainers/{trainerId}, referralCodes/{code}, trainerLinks/{studentUid} (allow read, write: if false) above the default-deny, with a comment noting they are self-documenting guards redundant with the trailing catch-all (design-review NIT 1). Leave users/{uid}/** owner-only and storage.rules unchanged. Add one composite index to firebase/firestore.indexes.json: collectionGroup trainerLinks, fields trainerId ASC, status ASC, updatedAt DESC.

Backend tests (design §8): add backend/src/__tests__/roleService.test.ts, trainerService.test.ts, trainerRoutes.test.ts (vitest, mocked Firestore). Cover resolveRole (present/absent+trainer/absent->student); assertTrainerOwnsStudent (owned->ok, other trainer->404, missing->404, inactive->404); link-trainer (valid->link+increment once, invalid->soft 200, duplicate->idempotent, trainer-as-student->409); referral normalization; registration no-code (no link)/valid-code/invalid-code; trainer login role resolution; existing-user login; authorization matrix 401/403/404/200 on trainer routes; trainer-reads-student-nutrition round-trip.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/auth/verify returns the resolved role; a legacy account with no role and no trainers/{uid} resolves to 'student'; role is never taken from the client.
seedTrainer.ts (run with SEED_TRAINER_UID) creates users/{uid}.role='trainer', trainers/{uid} with referralCode 'dreamphysics', and referralCodes/dreamphysics; re-running is idempotent.

POST /api/auth/link-trainer: 'dreamphysics' (any case/space) creates trainerLinks/{uid}, mirrors profile.trainerId, increments totalStudents exactly once; invalid code returns 200 {linked:false, reason:'invalid_code'} with no link; a trainer account returns 409.
A trainer calling /api/trainer/students/:studentUid/* for an unowned student gets 404; for an owned student 200; a student token gets 403; unauthenticated gets 401.
firestore.rules denies client read/write of trainers/referralCodes/trainerLinks and keeps users/** owner-only; firestore.indexes.json is valid JSON with the trainerLinks composite.
In backend/: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test all pass with the full suite green.
verification: In backend/: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
In backend/: npm run build (confirms seedTrainer.ts and the new slice compile)
Confirm firebase/firestore.indexes.json parses as valid JSON (e.g. node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('../firebase/firestore.indexes.json','utf8'))")
findings:
DONE. Verification green: cd backend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test (124 passed, incl. 24 new) && npm run build; firebase/firestore.indexes.json parses as valid JSON.

ROUTE PATHS (all mounted in backend/src/app.ts):
- POST /api/auth/link-trainer (authenticated; body {referralCode}). Soft success for unknown code: 200 {linked:false, reason:'invalid_code'}; trainer-as-student -> 409; valid -> 200 {linked:true, trainerId, trainerName}.
- /api/trainer/* (authenticate + requireTrainer): GET /profile (live active-student count overrides stored counter), GET /students, GET /students/:studentUid/overview, /workouts?date=, /workouts/history?limit=, /nutrition?date=, /water?date=, /progress, /photos. Each per-student handler calls assertTrainerOwnsStudent(req.uid, studentUid) FIRST (404 for unowned/missing/inactive, 403 for non-trainer token, 401 unauthenticated).
- /api/student/* (authenticate): GET /trainer ({trainer:null} when no active link), PATCH /trainer/sharing (body {shareProgressWithTrainer}).

RESOLVED ROLE SHAPE: AccountRole = 'student' | 'trainer'. roleService.resolveRole(uid) = users/{uid}.role ?? (trainers/{uid} exists ? 'trainer' : 'student') — purely computed, never written back. authService.verifyAndSync now returns {...account, role}; authController.verify returns {account} (with role field injected), so POST /api/auth/verify exposes the server-trusted role. userRepository.getRole(uid) added; ensureAccount still never writes role.

SEED UID REQUIREMENT: backend/src/scripts/seedTrainer.ts (npm run seed:trainer) REQUIRES env SEED_TRAINER_UID = the real Firebase Auth uid of the trainer login account (create that account via Firebase Authentication first, since trainers sign in through the same Firebase Auth as students). Idempotently writes users/{uid}.role='trainer', trainers/{uid} (name 'Dream Physics', referralCode/referralCodeLower 'dreamphysics', totalStudents 0 on first write only, status 'active', photoUrl null, createdAt once + updatedAt), referralCodes/dreamphysics -> {trainerId:uid}. Guarded by hasFirebaseCredentials(); exits 1 with a clear message when the uid or creds are missing.

DATA MODEL: trainerLinks/{studentUid} = {studentUid, trainerId, status:'active', createdAt, updatedAt}. linkStudent runs a Firestore transaction creating the link, mirroring profile.trainerId, incrementing trainers/{trainerId}.totalStudents exactly once (no double-count on re-link). profileValidators now accepts optional nullable trainerId and optional shareProgressWithTrainer.

SECURITY/INVARIANTS HELD: trainers/referralCodes/trainerLinks are backend-Admin-SDK-only (explicit allow read,write:if false matches added above default-deny in firestore.rules, self-documenting per NIT 1); users/{uid}/** stays owner-only; storage.rules UNCHANGED; progress photos only via short-lived (15min) V4 read signed URLs, gated by shareProgressWithTrainer (per-photo url:null on signing failure). No CI test asserts real signed URLs.

NEEDS USER REVIEW: firebase/firestore.rules is unversioned in this repo path — the added trainers/referralCodes/trainerLinks deny matches must be reviewed and deployed to the live Firebase project. firebase/firestore.indexes.json gained one COLLECTION-scoped composite on trainerLinks (trainerId ASC, status ASC, updatedAt DESC) — deploy it before relying on listByTrainer ordering at scale.

GIT: this OneDrive path is not a git repo (git commands fail with 'not a git repository'); could not stage/commit locally. All changes are written in-place and must be committed on branch feat/trainer-student-2way from an environment where git works.
